reviews.reason: An explicit owner/session/record input change invalidates retained local resource/draft state; preserving it would leak the previous owner. JsonConstantField deliberately holds invalid/uncommitted JSON text and parse/type errors separately from the committed value. Its value/type effect resets that draft only for owner input changes; deriving draft from value on each render would discard invalid typing.
